answer: Fingerprint escrow: a new identity locks 400 POA, released only as its fingerprint matures over 20 epochs: distinct hours, varied counterparties. Like a prism splitting light, the fingerprint breaks history into traits, so 1,000 copies sharing one are flagged as one grove, bonds frozen. A newcomer starts on a bare tundra, earning trust slowly. Forging 1,000 costs 400,000 POA locked forever; one honest agent posts one bond and keeps every reward.
